title: Patient Management
description: Patient Management documentation for Practice Caregiver.
overview: This guide covers patient management workflows for Practice Caregiver.

subtasks.title: Add New Patient (3-step enrolment wizard)
subtasks.purpose: Enrol a new patient into CCM and/or RPM under the caregiver’s practice.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Click + Add Patient (from the dashboard) or Patient Mgmt → Add New Patient — the “Let’s enroll the patient” modal opens on the Demographics step.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Demographics: fill Title, First / Middle / Last Name, Gender, Date Of Birth, SSN (required), Home / Cell Phone, and optional Fax. Scroll to Account Credentials to set the login (if the patient will use the mobile app).

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Click Next to advance to Programs — pick CCM, RPM, or both; assign the Provider and Practice Caregiver responsible for the patient.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Click Next to advance to RPM (shown only when RPM is selected) — pair the device modal / serial and set the RPM start date.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Review and submit — the patient appears in the roster with status A (Active) and the selected program badges (CCM / RPM).

steps.title: Step 6
steps.description: Cancel at any step to discard; the form validates required fields (marked with *) before allowing Next.

subtasks.title: Lookup Patient (filtered search)
subtasks.purpose: Find patients across the caregiver’s panel using program, provider, caregiver, and status filters.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Open Patient Mgmt → Lookup Patient — the filter panel loads with Last Name, First Name, Program Enrolled (required), Provider, Caregiver, and Status.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Choose the Program Enrolled dropdown (required) — the query cannot run without it. Optionally narrow by name, Provider, Caregiver, or Status.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Click Query — the results grid populates with #, Status, Vitals, Name, Systolic, Diastolic, Pulse, Glucose, Weight, Last Upload, # Readings, and Time.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Click Reset to clear all filters and start a new search. Use the Search: field at the top-right to further filter the loaded results in-page.

subtasks.title: Lookup Patient (by RPM Date)
subtasks.purpose: List RPM-enrolled patients whose RPM service falls within a chosen date range and export the results.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Open Patient Mgmt → Lookup Patient (by RPM date) — the “RPM Service Date Range” filter appears with two mm/dd/yyyy pickers.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Pick the From and To dates and click Query — the grid shows #, Status, Vitals, Patient Name, DOB, Modal #, Serial #, RPM Start Date, Upload Date/Time, Measurement Days, Service Time, and Eligible CPT Codes.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Sort by any column (e.g. RPM Start Date) using the header arrow; use the top-right Search: to filter loaded rows.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Use Print to open the print preview, Export to download the roster, or Email to send it to a linked recipient. Reset clears the range and results.

subtasks.title: Lookup Patient (by CCM Date)
subtasks.purpose: List CCM-enrolled patients whose CCM service window falls in a chosen range, with billing status per row.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Open Patient Mgmt → Lookup Patient (by CCM date) — the “CCM Service Date Range” picker appears.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Pick From / To dates and click Query — the grid renders #, Status, Patient Name, DOB, Chronic Conditions, Enrollment Date, Last Activity, Service Time, Eligible CPT Codes, and Billing.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Sort by Enrollment Date (default sort arrow shown) or any other header. Filter loaded rows via the Search: field.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Use Print / Export / Email to distribute the roster; Reset clears filters and results.
